dct_description_sm: To monitor changes in physical, biological and geochemical properties of the Canadian Arctic and Subarctic waters, ocean observatories (moorings) were deployed in Baffin Bay part of the ArcticNet field program. These moorings are the oceanic equivalent of atmospheric meteorological stations. The data are used to describe the seasonal and annual variations in the Arctic environment and its local ecosystems. This, in turn, enables us to understand how, and how quickly, global warming is affecting the Arctic.
dct_title_s: Long-term oceanic observatories (moorings) in Baffin Bay during ArcticNet 2005-2006
